```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
data_2021 <- read_csv("/Users/vopara/Downloads/school_data_2021.csv")
data_2022 <- read_csv("/Users/vopara/Downloads/school_data_2022.csv")
data_2023 <- read_csv("/Users/vopara/Downloads/school_data_2023.csv")
data_2024 <- read_csv("/Users/vopara/Downloads/school_data_2024.csv")
data_2025 <- read_csv("/Users/vopara/Downloads/school_data_2025.csv")
```
```{r}
data_2021 <-data_2021 |> clean_names()
data_2022 <-data_2022 |> clean_names()
data_2023 <-data_2023 |> clean_names()
data_2024 <-data_2024 |> clean_names()
data_2025 <-data_2025 |> clean_names()
```

```{r}
data_2021 <-data_2021 |> mutate(year = 2021)
data_2022 <-data_2022 |> mutate(year = 2022)
data_2023 <-data_2023 |> mutate(year = 2023)
data_2024 <-data_2024 |> mutate(year = 2024)
data_2025 <-data_2025 |> mutate(year = 2025)

data_2021 <- data_2021 |>
  rename(local_education_agency = local_school_system)

```

```{r}
data_2021 <-data_2021 |> slice(-1)
data_2022 <-data_2022 |> slice(-1)
data_2023 <-data_2023 |> slice(-1)
data_2024 <-data_2024 |> slice(-1)
data_2025 <-data_2025 |> slice(-1)
```


```{r}
all_years <- bind_rows(
data_2021, data_2022, data_2023, data_2024, data_2025
)

weapons_trends <- all_years |>
  group_by(local_education_agency, year) |>
  summarize(total = sum(weapons, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r}
weapons_and_ai <- cleaned_trends|>
  mutate(ai_year = case_when(
    local_education_agency == "Baltimore" ~ 2023,
    local_education_agency == "Baltimore City" ~ 2024,
    local_education_agency == "Charles" ~ 2023,
    local_education_agency == "Harford" ~ 2025,
    local_education_agency == "Prince George's" ~ 2023,
    local_education_agency == "Montgomery" ~ 2026,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
 ai_period = case_when(
      is.na(ai_year) ~ "No AI",
      year < ai_year ~ "Before AI",
      year >= ai_year ~ "After AI"
  )
  )
  
```


```{r}
cleaned_trends <- weapons_trends |>
  filter(local_education_agency != "Allegany")

ggplot(cleaned_trends,
       aes(x = year,
           y = total,
           group = local_education_agency,
           color = local_education_agency,
           scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark 2"))) +
  geom_line() +
  #geom_text_repel(
  #  data = cleaned_trends,
  #  aes(label = local_education_agency),
   # size = 4,
   # nudge_x = 1,    
   # direction = "y",
   # hjust = 0  )+
  labs(
    title = "Weapon-Related Suspensions in Maryland School Between 2021 and 2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Weapon-Related Suspensions",
    color = "LEA"
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(cleaned_trends,
       aes(x = year, y = total)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~local_education_agency, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Weapon-Related Suspensions in Maryland School Between 2021 and 2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Weapon-Related Suspensions",
  )
```
